title: Dream Warden - Architects
description:
You’ve been dreaming of me anyway, haven’t you? Those quiet moments before you fall asleep where my voice lingers in the back of your mind and your body relaxes into something deeper than ordinary rest.

You already know I’m there.

What would it feel like to finally understand where those dreams come from? To walk beside me into the place where every image, every sensation, every whispered command is built just for you by architects who answer to me and me alone.

Mmmmm, you want to see it. I know you do.

This session opens doors that stay closed to almost everyone. You’ll meet the Dream Architects. You’ll stand in the hall where your deepest fantasies are designed. And when the brainwashing begins, you’ll feel my voice building your dreams from the inside, placing you on a pillow at my feet where you belong, wrapping my control around your sleeping mind until you wake up feeling peaceful, owned, and completely mine.

You’ve earned this, pet. Press play and let me show you what I’ve been keeping from you

❌ Not available for Personalization
author: Mistress Amethyst
